content.json:
# AI Gateway Tokenomics
Cost and consumption of every **agent** (APIM subscription) and **plan** (APIM product) across the three AI Gateway surfaces: **AI models** (Foundry), **MCP tools** and **A2A agents**, as measured by Azure API Management. Spend that an A2A agent makes on a caller's behalf is attributed to the **caller** (`Via` = the agent). Prices come from the `model-pricing`, `tool-pricing` and `agent-pricing` named values.

content.query:
let cost = toscalar(customMetrics | where name == "CostMicroUSD" | summarize sum(valueSum)) / 1e6;
let tokens = toscalar(customMetrics | where name == "Total Tokens" | summarize sum(valueSum));
let calls = toscalar(requests
| where url has "/openai/" or url has "/commerce-mcp" or url has "/sourcing-agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"])
| count);
let blocked = toscalar(requests
| where url has "/openai/" or url has "/commerce-mcp" or url has "/sourcing-agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"])
| where resultCode in ("401", "403", "429") | count);
print Metric = "Total cost (USD)", Value = round(cost, 4)
| union (print Metric = "Total tokens", Value = todouble(tokens))
| union (print Metric = "Gateway calls", Value = todouble(calls))
| union (print Metric = "Blocked by policy (401/403/429)", Value = todouble(blocked))
content.title: Totals

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize CostUSD = sum(valueSum) / 1e6 by Agent, Surface
| order by CostUSD desc
content.title: Cost by agent and surface (USD)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize CostUSD = sum(valueSum) / 1e6 by Surface
| order by CostUSD desc
content.title: Cost by surface: AI models, MCP tools, A2A agents (USD)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize CostUSD = round(sum(valueSum) / 1e6, 6), Calls = sum(valueCount) by Agent, Tier, Surface, Via
| order by Agent asc, CostUSD desc
content.title: Chargeback: who pays for what (Via = the A2A agent that spent on the payer's behalf)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize CostUSD = round(sum(valueSum) / 1e6, 6), Calls = sum(valueCount) by Surface, Resource = Model
| extend AvgCostPerCallUSD = round(CostUSD / Calls, 6)
| order by CostUSD desc
content.title: Cost by model, tool and agent (USD)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| where Surface == "model"
| summarize CostUSD = sum(valueSum) / 1e6 by Model
| order by CostUSD desc
content.title: Model cost (USD)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize CostUSD = sum(valueSum) / 1e6 by Agent, bin(timestamp, 1m)
content.title: Cost over time by agent (USD)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize PromptTokens = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Tokens"), CompletionTokens = sumif(valueSum, name == "Completion Tokens") by Agent, Tier, Via, Model
| extend TotalTokens = PromptTokens + CompletionTokens
| order by TotalTokens desc
content.title: Tokens by agent and model

content.query:
let budgets = datatable(Agent:string, AgentName:string, Tier:string, BudgetMicroUsd:long)[{budget-rows}];
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"]), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Surface"]), "model"), Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Via"]), "direct")
| summarize SpentMicroUsd = sum(valueSum) by Agent
| join kind=rightouter budgets on Agent
| project Agent = Agent1, AgentName, Tier, BudgetUSD = BudgetMicroUsd / 1e6, SpentUSD = coalesce(SpentMicroUsd, 0.0) / 1e6
| extend UsedPercent = round(100.0 * SpentUSD / BudgetUSD, 1)
| order by UsedPercent desc
content.title: Budget vs spend by agent

content.query:
requests
| where url has "/openai/" or url has "/commerce-mcp" or url has "/sourcing-agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"])
| summarize Calls = count() by Agent, resultCode
content.title: Gateway outcomes by agent (status code)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "GovernanceEvents"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"]), Event = tostring(customDimensions["Event"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"])
| summarize Events = sum(valueSum) by Agent, Tier, Event, RequestedModel = Model
| order by Events desc
content.title: Governance actions (model downgrade / deny, output cap, tool / agent denied)

content.query:
requests
| where url has "/openai/" or url has "/commerce-mcp" or url has "/sourcing-agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"])
| where resultCode in ("401", "403", "429")
| summarize Calls = count() by resultCode, bin(timestamp, 1m)
content.title: Blocked calls over time (429 = rate limit, 403 = entitlement / quota / budget)

content.json:
## Policies in action
Evidence of the gateway policies, from the **Log Analytics** diagnostic tables (`ApiManagementGatewayLogs`, `ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog`, `ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog`) and the gateway's custom metrics. `LastErrorSource` is the policy that stopped a call; `CorrelationId` equals the `x-gw-request-id` response header.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ApiId in ("inference-api", "commerce-mcp", "sourcing-agent")
| extend Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(passed)", LastErrorSource)
| summarize Requests = count() by Policy, ResponseCode, Plan = ProductId
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Gateway outcomes by policy (LastErrorSource = the policy that stopped the call)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where LastErrorSource == "validate-azure-ad-token"
| summarize Rejected = count() by Plan = ProductId, ApiId, LastErrorReason
| order by Rejected desc
content.title: Microsoft Entra ID: rejected calls (validate-azure-ad-token)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ApiId == "inference-api" and isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend Backend = tostring(split(parse_url(BackendUrl).Host, ".")[0])
| summarize Calls = count() by Backend, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
content.title: Load balancing: which Foundry region served the AI model calls

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "BackendAttempts"
| extend Backend = tostring(customDimensions["Backend"]), Region = tostring(customDimensions["Region"]), Failover = tostring(customDimensions["Failover"]), Model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"])
| summarize Requests = sum(valueCount), Attempts = sum(valueSum) by Backend, Region, Failover, Model
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Failover: gateway attempts per request (BackendAttempts metric, Failover = retried on another region)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where isnotempty(DeploymentName)
| summarize Calls = dcount(CorrelationId), PromptTokens = sum(PromptTokens), CompletionTokens = sum(CompletionTokens) by DeploymentName
| order by PromptTokens desc
content.title: Tokens counted by the gateway per deployment (ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog
| where isnotempty(ToolName)
| summarize Calls = count(), Errors = countif(isnotempty(Error)) by ToolName, ClientName, AuthenticationMethod
| order by Calls desc
content.title: MCP tool calls (ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Caller = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Caller"]), "unknown"), Agent = tostring(customDimensions["Agent"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["Tier"])
| summarize CostUSD = round(sum(valueSum) / 1e6, 6), Calls = sum(valueCount) by Caller, Agent, Tier
| order by CostUSD desc
content.title: Cost by caller identity (Entra ID) and plan
